style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly on a textured weathered concrete surface. An unlatched industrial inspection gate mechanism in brushed steel forcefully blocks small incoming modular routing blocks while an authorized block rests securely inside the shielded bay. Hard clean edges, extreme asymmetric off-centre framing with the gate commanding the left side of the frame, generous negative space on the right. One dramatic directional light throwing a long cast shadow across the concrete, matte muted palette with a single caution-yellow accent on the latch. No text.
negative_prompt: garbled text, numbers, letters, watermark, UI, letters, words
rationale: The story focuses on a systemic rule shift—a modular gate taking control away from individual callers. Component assembly perfectly illustrates a hard systemic boundary or inspection point restricting flow, using constructed architectural metaphor.
subject: a heavy industrial inspection gate blocking modular routing tokens
core_thesis: The right to retry failed calls has moved to the error owner to prevent unauthorized agents from causing severe network retry storms.
core_conflict: Agentic persistence vs systemic control and strict error ownership boundaries.
